description: This file provides functions to generate travel itineraries using the OpenAI API, including a fallback demo itinerary. It retrieves API keys and configuration from environment variables, constructs prompts for the API, handles responses, and exports the primary function for external use.
external_files: fetch API (built-in or global in the environment)

methods.name: generateItinerary({ destination, dates, preferences, weather, events })
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a travel itinerary by calling OpenAI's chat completion API, using inputs such as destination, dates, preferences, weather, and events; falls back to a demo itinerary if API key is missing or request fails.

methods.name: demoItinerary(destination)
methods.description: Returns a sample static itinerary data structure for a given destination, used as a fallback response.

ctags.name: generateItinerary
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generateItinerary({ destination, dates, preferences, weather, events }) {$/
